title.en: Differentiate eˣ, aˣ and log x
Use logarithmic differentiation for u(x)^v(x) and long products

say.en: How do you differentiate x to the power x? Neither the power rule nor the exponential rule fits. Taking logarithms first brings the power down and makes it easy. In this lesson: Differentiate e to the power x, a to the power x and log x.
Use logarithmic differentiation for ux^vx and long products.

body.en: $\frac{d}{dx}e^x = e^x$, $\frac{d}{dx}\log x = \frac{1}{x}$ ($x > 0$), $\frac{d}{dx}a^x = a^x \log a$. With the chain rule, $\frac{d}{dx}e^{g(x)} = e^{g(x)}g'(x)$ and $\frac{d}{dx}\log g(x) = \frac{g'(x)}{g(x)}$.
body.kn: eˣ ನ ಅವಕಲಜ eˣ, log x ನದು 1/x, aˣ ನದು aˣ log a.

narration.en: The derivative of e to the x is itself. The derivative of log x is one by x. And a to the x differentiates to a to the x times log a.
narration.kn: eˣ ನ ಅವಕಲಜ eˣ, log x ನದು 1/x, aˣ ನದು aˣ log a.

say.en: The derivative of e to the x is itself. The derivative of log x is one by x. And a to the x differentiates to a to the x times log a. d over dx e to the power x equals e to the power x.
say.kn: e to the power x ನ ಅವಕಲಜ e to the power x, log x ನದು 1 over x, a to the power x ನದು a to the power x log a.

say.en: d over dx log x equals 1 over x.
d over dx a to the power x equals a to the power x log a.

title.en: eˣ, log x, and taking logs first

say.en: e to the x and log x are mirror images in y equals x. e to the x is its own derivative.
For x to the power x, neither power rule nor exponential rule applies. Take logs first.
Differentiate both sides: 1 over y times d y by d x equals log x plus 1. Multiply back by y.
The derivative is zero when log x equals minus 1, that is at x equals 1 over e.

body.en: For $y = [u(x)]^{v(x)}$, take logs: $\log y = v \log u$. Differentiate: $\frac{1}{y}\frac{dy}{dx} = v'\log u + \frac{v u'}{u}$. Multiply by $y$. The same trick turns long products and quotients into sums.
body.kn: y = u^v ಗೆ ಲಘುಗಣಕ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ: log y = v log u. ನಂತರ ಅವಕಲಿಸಿ y ಯಿಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿ.

steps.en: (1/y) dy/dx = log x + x · (1/x) = 1 + log x.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Differentiate y = xˣ, x > 0.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Differentiate y equals x to the power x, x is greater than 0.
log y equals x log x.
(1 over y) dy over dx equals log x plus x (1 over x) equals 1 plus log x.
dy over dx equals x to the power x1 plus log x.
So the answer is x to the power x1 plus log x.

problem.en: Differentiate e^(sin x) and log(log x).

steps.en: d/dx e^(sin x) = e^(sin x) · cos x.

answer.en: cos x · e^(sin x) and 1/(x log x)

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Differentiate e^(sin x) and log(log x).

say.en: Let us solve this together. Differentiate e^sin x and loglog x.
d over dx e^sin x equals e^sin x cos x.
d over dx loglog x equals (1 over log x) (1 over x).
So the answer is cos x e^sin x and 1 over x log x.
